Hi Samira / Carlos — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights
- Primary use: real-time summarization + search for customer support transcripts (avg. 300–600 tokens per request, heavy tail to 4k).
- Current lambda: proof-of-concept using single GPU; production needs predictable latency and cost.
- Key success metric: reduce AGI infra cost to <$10k/mo while meeting 99th percentile latency SLOs.

Pricing info we need to lock down
1) Target unit economics: what target $/1M tokens would make a committed plan compelling for you?
2) Budget range: what is the monthly budget range you can commit to over the next 6/12/24 months? (ballpark is fine)
3) Volume profile: expected monthly tokens (or range) after launch; any seasonality expected?

Incentives we discussed
- Startup program: credits + waived onboarding fee if you qualify (early-stage criteria included in attached PDF).
- Committed discounts: tiered discounts for 6/12/24-month commitments; deeper discounts for upfront multi-year.
- Convertible path: start with a smaller commitment + option to add capacity and convert into a longer-term rebate structure.

Attached: redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx (three starter scenarios), startup-credit-criteria.pdf, MAA-2026-02.docx (ops checklist).

Next steps
- Can you share the budget range and a target $/1M tokens (even a band: $X–$Y)?
- If comfortable, we can draft a 6-month starter commitment with an optional extension clause for multi-year incentives.
- Proposed follow-up: 30-minute call Friday 2/20 to review scenarios and lock on path.

I’ll loop Marcus in for onboarding/ops details once we have the target band. Thanks —

Thanks Irene — great demo, appreciated the scenarios. Quick answers below: 

Budget and target unit economics
- Budget: For launch (Q2) we can commit ~$8k–$15k/month. If we see traction, we can scale to ~$40k/mo within 9–12 months.
- Target $/1M tokens: Ideally we’re aiming for ~$600–$900 per 1M tokens to make the economics work for our unit margins. 

Volume profile
- Expected: 10M–25M tokens/month first 3 months (pilot + early customers), rising toward 50M+/month by month 9 if usage ramps.
- Seasonality: nothing material expected beyond gradual ramp.

Incentives/questions
- We are seed-stage (18 months runway). Startup credit would be helpful to stretch runway — what are the main qualifiers?
- If we pursue committed discounts, is the minimum meaningful term 6 months? 12? We’d like flexibility but need a path to a deeper multi-year rebate if we hit targets.

Happy to hop on Friday; Friday morning PST works for us.

Hi Samira / Carlos — following up with some concrete pricing scenarios based on the ranges you gave. Numbers are illustrative but reflect the configurations we recommend for low-latency summarization workloads. All prices are per 1M tokens.

Scenario A — Pay-as-you-go (no commit)
- Unit price: $1,250 / 1M tokens
- Pros: zero commitment, immediate scale
- Cons: highest unit cost

Scenario B — 6-month starter commit
- Minimum commit: $45k over 6 months (paid monthly or upfront)
- Effective unit price band: $900–$1,000 / 1M tokens depending on actual usage (higher discounts if monthly average >20M tokens)
- Includes: 3k onboarding credit + 10% discount on model variants for first 3 months

Scenario C — 24-month convertible commit (multi-year rebate)
- Minimum annualized commit: $300k/year (can be structured as 12 or 24 payments)
- Effective unit price band: $600–$750 / 1M tokens with quarterly true-ups and a rebate/credit at year-end tied to volume thresholds
- Pros: deepest unit economics and reserved capacity; Cons: requires longer-term commitment (but convertible path available if you want to start smaller and convert)

Startup program notes
- Typical qualifiers: company stage (Seed/Series A), active dev traction, public domain references, and a quick security self-attestation. See attached PDF for full checklist.
- We can combine startup credits with a 6-month starter commit to reduce upfront cash requirements.

Ask from you
- Can you confirm the month-1 expected token volume and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs upfront)?
- Do you have a target $/1M token threshold within your stated $600–$900 band that would drive you to choose Scenario B vs C?

If helpful, I can produce a one-page commitment term sheet for the 6-month starter by EOD; we can include optional extension terms to convert into the 24-month rebate program.

Best,
Ben Carter
